create_pipeline_generate_music: create an AceStepPipeline instance and generate music from a text prompt with lyrics and metadata
run_pipeline_repaint_audio: run the AceStepPipeline to repaint a section of existing audio with a new prompt and time range
run_pipeline_cover_timbre_transfer: run the AceStepPipeline cover task to generate audio with timbre transfer from reference audio
build_task_instruction: build a task-specific instruction string for extract, lego, or complete tasks from the AceStepPipeline
run_pipeline_extract_track: run the AceStepPipeline extract task to isolate a specific track like vocals or drums from mixed audio
